notes: The fronted 'They' of 'They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously' realizes the substantival article on הַבּוֹגְדִים together with the 'that', not the person and number of יֵבֹשׁוּ: an explicit subject stands in the clause, so rule 17 leaves the verb only its auxiliaries and lexical verb, and rule 41 gives the article both halves of the supplied pronoun-plus-relative, headed on the pronoun.
